title: Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.17320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic optimization models sequential decision-making under uncertainty, typically assuming known input distributions. When these distributions are unknown, \citet{agarwal2026semibandit} give an online-to-offline reduction for monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, where only probed variables are observed. Its expected regret relative to the offline guarantee is $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$, where $n$ is the number of variables and $T$ the horizon. For optimal stopping and Pandora's box, \citet{liu2025improved} achieve $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ using problem-specific algorithms. \emph{Can a general online-to-offline reduction achieve this improved rate?}   We give such a reduction for strongly monotone stochastic optimization, answering the corresponding open question. Strong monotonicity is defined relative to the chosen offline algorithm. Our oracle-efficient reduction achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ expected

translated_title: 半臂反馈下单调随机优化的近最优后悔界
translated_abstract: 随机优化研究不确定性下的序贯决策问题，通常假设输入分布是已知的。当这些分布未知时，Agarwal等人（2026）针对半臂反馈下的单调随机优化（即仅观测被探测变量的取值）提出了一种从在线到离线的归约方法，其相对于离线保证的期望后悔度为 $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$，其中 $n$ 是变量数量，$T$ 是时间范围。对于最优停止问题和潘多拉盒子问题，Liu等人（2025）利用针对具体问题的算法达到了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ 的界。那么，一个通用的在线到离线归约能否达到这一更优的速率？我们对强单调随机优化给出了这样一个归约，回答了相应的开放性问题。强单调性是相对于所选离线算法定义的。我们提出的预言机高效（oracle-efficient）归约实现了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ 的期望后悔界。
tldr: 本文提出一种通用的、预言机高效的在线到离线归约，使强单调随机优化在半臂反馈下的期望后悔界达到近最优的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$，从而回答了该领域的一个开放性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a general, oracle-efficient online-to-offline reduction that achieves a near-optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ expected regret for strongly monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, resolving an open question in the field.
